image_description: Two pieces of rusted, textured metal armor plates (likely breastplate components) resting on a solid yellow background. The plate on the right is upright and shield-shaped with visible rivets and a central vertical ridge. The plate on the left is lying on its side, showing a curved profile and attachment points. Both exhibit a heavy, pitted texture resembling rust or aged bronze rather than polished steel.
